files.caption: Two photographs of 229 North Miami Street, Trenton, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 229 North Miami Street reads: A very good 7-room home on a good size lot. Across street from school. Has 3 large bedrooms and bath on second floor with stairs to partly finished third floor. Four large rooms on first floor. Basement under all with warm air furnace. Two-car garage. Shown by appointment. Quotation twelve thousand.
